locale.description: 文言の言語。表示の言語で処理を分けるときに使う。

extDescription.message: A command palette that opens with Cmd+T. Control the browser, switch tabs, and search history and bookmarks from the keyboard.

openPaletteDescription.message: Open the palette over the current page

searchPlaceholder.message: Search commands, tabs, bookmarks, and history

favoritesNoUrl.message: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://

favoritesNoName.message: Enter a name before the URL

siteSearchMissingFields.message: Enter a keyword, a name, and a URL separated by spaces

siteSearchBadScheme.message: The URL must start with http:// or https://

siteSearchDuplicateKeyword.message: The keyword $KEYWORD$ is already in use

readingListEmptyHint.message: Use Add to Reading List to save the current page

readingListCannotAdd.message: This page can't be added to the reading list

readingListNotFound.message: This page isn't in your reading list

noStaleTabs.message: No tabs have gone unviewed for $HOURS$ hours or more

staleEnabledLabel.message: Show Archive Stale Tabs in the palette

staleHoursLabel.message: Archive Stale Tabs closes tabs not viewed for

staleIncludeGroupedLabel.message: Also close tabs in tab groups

newWindowPinsLabel.message: New Window also opens the current window's pinned tabs

favoritesNote.message: One per line: `name URL aliases…`. Typing a name or alias puts the favorite near the top. If a tab whose URL starts with it is open, the palette switches to that tab.

siteSearchNote.message: One per line: `keyword name URL`. `%s` in the URL is replaced with the search term.

command_reopen_tab.message: Bring back the last closed tab

command_close_other_tabs.message: Close all unpinned tabs except this one

command_close_right_tabs.message: Close unpinned tabs to the right

command_close_left_tabs.message: Close unpinned tabs to the left

command_archive_stale_tabs.message: Close tabs you haven't viewed in a while

command_close_duplicate_tabs.message: Close tabs with the same URL

command_close_other_windows.message: Close other browser windows, keeping popups open

command_duplicate.message: Open a copy of the current tab

command_pin.message: Pin or unpin the current tab

command_mute.message: Mute or unmute the current tab

command_move_to_window.message: Move the current tab to a new window

command_bookmark.message: Add the current page to bookmarks

command_add_to_reading_list.message: Save the current page to read later

command_mark_as_read.message: Mark the current page as read in the reading list

groupTabUnnamed.message: Create a group without a name

groupTabHint.message: Moves the current tab into a new group

tabNotInGroup.message: This tab isn't in a group

noTabsToGroupByDomain.message: No tabs to group by domain

command_group_tab.message: Move the current tab into a new named group

command_ungroup_tab.message: Remove the current tab from its group

command_group_tabs_by_domain.message: Group tabs in this window by domain

command_sort_tabs_by_domain.message: Sort tabs in this window by domain

noTabGroups.message: No tab groups in this window

command_close_tab_group.message: Close every tab in the current tab's group

command_close_tab_groups.message: Pick a tab group in this window and close its tabs
